ballot_resolution_state.name: ballot_resolution_state
ballot_resolution_state.value: ("ballot"."status" = 'OPEN' and "ballot"."resolution" is null and "ballot"."resolved_at" is null) or ("ballot"."status" = 'RESOLVED' and "ballot"."resolution" is not null and "ballot"."resolved_at" is not null) or ("ballot"."status" = 'EXPIRED' and "ballot"."resolution" is null and "ballot"."resolved_at" is null)

event_whitelist_approval.name: event_whitelist_approval
event_whitelist_approval.value: not "event"."is_t1_whitelisted" or ("event"."whitelist_reason" <> 'NONE' and "event"."approved_at" is not null and "event"."approved_by" is not null)

pending_import_review_state.name: pending_import_review_state
pending_import_review_state.value: ("pending_import_change"."status" = 'PENDING' and "pending_import_change"."reviewed_at" is null and "pending_import_change"."reviewed_by" is null and "pending_import_change"."review_reason" is null and "pending_import_change"."applied_at" is null) or ("pending_import_change"."status" = 'APPROVED' and "pending_import_change"."reviewed_at" is not null and "pending_import_change"."reviewed_by" is not null and length(btrim("pending_import_change"."review_reason")) > 0 and "pending_import_change"."applied_at" is not null) or ("pending_import_change"."status" = 'REJECTED' and "pending_import_change"."reviewed_at" is not null and "pending_import_change"."reviewed_by" is not null and length(btrim("pending_import_change"."review_reason")) > 0 and "pending_import_change"."applied_at" is null) or ("pending_import_change"."status" = 'SUPERSEDED' and "pending_import_change"."applied_at" is null)

player_stat_period_order.name: player_stat_period_order
player_stat_period_order.value: "player_stat_snapshot"."period_start" is null or "player_stat_snapshot"."period_end" is null or "player_stat_snapshot"."period_end" >= "player_stat_snapshot"."period_start"

pool_player_source_shape.name: pool_player_source_shape
pool_player_source_shape.value: ("pool_player_entry"."admission_type" = 'SPECIAL' and "pool_player_entry"."source_team_entry_id" is null) or ("pool_player_entry"."admission_type" <> 'SPECIAL' and "pool_player_entry"."source_team_entry_id" is not null)

pool_player_pairing_state.name: pool_player_pairing_state
pool_player_pairing_state.value: ("pool_player_entry"."pairing_enabled" and "pool_player_entry"."pairing_disabled_at" is null and "pool_player_entry"."pairing_disabled_reason" is null) or (not "pool_player_entry"."pairing_enabled" and "pool_player_entry"."pairing_disabled_at" is not null and length(btrim("pool_player_entry"."pairing_disabled_reason")) > 0)

ranking_source_approval_shape.name: ranking_source_approval_shape
ranking_source_approval_shape.value: ("ranking_source_snapshot"."approved_at" is null and "ranking_source_snapshot"."approved_by" is null) or ("ranking_source_snapshot"."approved_at" is not null and "ranking_source_snapshot"."approved_by" is not null)

risk_observation_has_pseudonymous_subjec.name: risk_observation_has_pseudonymous_subject
risk_observation_has_pseudonymous_subjec.value: "risk_observation"."visitor_id" is not null or "risk_observation"."ip_risk_key" is not null

sync_run_lifecycle.name: sync_run_lifecycle
sync_run_lifecycle.value: ("sync_run"."status" = 'RUNNING' and "sync_run"."finished_at" is null) or ("sync_run"."status" <> 'RUNNING' and "sync_run"."finished_at" is not null and "sync_run"."finished_at" >= "sync_run"."started_at")

vote_choice_player_shape.name: vote_choice_player_shape
vote_choice_player_shape.value: ("vote"."choice" = 'SKIP' and "vote"."winner_player_id" is null and "vote"."loser_player_id" is null) or ("vote"."choice" <> 'SKIP' and "vote"."winner_player_id" is not null and "vote"."loser_player_id" is not null and "vote"."winner_player_id" <> "vote"."loser_player_id")

vote_revocation_state.name: vote_revocation_state
vote_revocation_state.value: ("vote"."status" = 'REVOKED' and "vote"."revoked_at" is not null and "vote"."revoked_by" is not null and length(btrim("vote"."revoked_reason")) > 0) or ("vote"."status" <> 'REVOKED' and "vote"."revoked_at" is null and "vote"."revoked_by" is null and "vote"."revoked_reason" is null)
